title: talentsear.ch, x-ray search for recruiters
excerpt: X-ray search for recruiters and job seekers, with predefined filters across professional and creative platforms.
content:
01 · Discover

The problem

Recruiters write the same long search-engine queries again and again to find people on LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance and Dribbble.

03 · Build

The tool

talentsear.ch turns those x-ray searches into predefined filters on top of Google Custom Search Engine, so a search that used to take a hand-written query takes a few clicks.
